# Widget `categorize` — Sort into groups

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use when items belong to 2–4 classes the learner must tell apart (types, families, true/false groups).

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "categorize",
  "title": "Sort into groups",
  "props": {
    "prompt": "Sort the examples.",
    "categories": [
      "Renewable",
      "Non-renewable"
    ],
    "items": [
      {
        "text": "Wind",
        "category": "Renewable"
      },
      {
        "text": "Coal",
        "category": "Non-renewable"
      },
      {
        "text": "Solar",
        "category": "Renewable"
      },
      {
        "text": "Natural gas",
        "category": "Non-renewable"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | no |
| `categories` | array of string (2–4) | yes |
| `items` | array of object (4–12) | yes |
| `items[].text` | string | yes |
| `items[].category` | string | yes |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
